portfolio_goal: Executable long-horizon RL for AI engineering: train agents to improve models, code and ML systems while preserving trusted evaluation and systems provenance.
claim_policy: A track is portfolio-ready only when its required real-workload evidence is retained. Implemented harnesses, toy tasks and synthetic measurements are supporting evidence, not substitutes.

rsi_research_automation.target: AI4AI / research automation for ML systems and machine-learning engineering
required_evidence: real model-development tasks such as inference optimization, training debugging or kernel/performance work
full experiment provenance and negative outcomes

long_horizon_rl.target: multi-step and multi-hour agentic RL with delayed credit and recovery
required_evidence: real completed trajectories lasting at least tens of minutes with a declared multi-hour budget
resume after injected failure without task corruption
held-out long-horizon task success after training

coding_rl.target: RL for real software engineering and coding agents
existing: isolated Docker public and hidden graders
required_evidence: real repository tasks rather than affine toy functions
trajectory analysis showing useful exploration and self-verification

grok_infra.target: RL training/inference infrastructure and production-style reliability
existing: distributed verifier RPC and adaptive routing
required_evidence: measured optimization or upstream impact in verl, SGLang or vLLM

built_grok_end_to_end.target: end-to-end model-building judgment across data, training, agents, evaluation and serving
required_evidence: model capability improvement on independent evaluation

post_training_rl.target: reward modeling, preference optimization and RL for capability improvement
required_evidence: positive or honestly retained null real-model held-out RL result
learned reward-model calibration and policy-shift degradation
DPO or preference-optimization baseline on the same split
reasoning/coding capability result rather than training reward alone
